metadata.description: 24 modular skills for idiomatic Go 1.27, derived from Effective Go, Google Go Style Guide, Uber Go Style Guide, and Go Wiki CodeReviewComments. Backed by 74 reference files, 11 automation scripts (--json on all eleven, --limit where output is unbounded, --force on the three that write files), 5 asset templates, a go-verify subagent, a PostToolUse hook that runs gofmt, vet, go fix, the package tests, and golangci-lint after every Go edit, a routing gate for the go-code, go-code-refactor, and go-code-review routers, and prompt and subagent hooks that name the router.

plugins.name: golang-skills
plugins.description: 24 Go 1.27 skills (each under 400 lines) with progressive disclosure, conditional cross-references, a shared verification gate enforced by the bundled golangci-lint baseline, a go-verify subagent, a PostToolUse hook that runs gofmt, vet, go fix, tests, and golangci-lint after every Go edit, a routing gate for the go-code, go-code-refactor, and go-code-review routers, and prompt and subagent hooks that name the router. Covers HTTP, database access, security, resilience, troubleshooting, behavior-preserving refactoring, style, naming, error handling, testing, concurrency, generics, logging, documentation, performance, and more.
